items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: You want the right name of Nathan or Jim Robinson? Yeah, everything about it. Your real name is Nathan.

ctx.x: You can just give your name first, who you are and when you were born, Jim.
You want the right name of Nathan or Jim Robinson? Yeah, everything about it. Your real name is Nathan. Nathan, yeah.
But you wouldn't want us to tell anybody.
